> **`v0.15.1` was not published to PyPI.** Its release candidate passed the build, library tests, cookbook smoke and real-Azure certification, but the cookbook host-boot smoke gate failed: its test-collection check ran with the cookbook's coverage threshold, so collecting (not running) the tests failed `Required test coverage of 95.0% not reached` (exit code 1), and the publish job was skipped. `0.15.3`, tagged about 40 minutes later, is the first published release after `0.15.0` and contains every change listed here. The tag is kept unchanged as an audit record; see [Release history and provenance](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-logging-python/blob/main/docs/release_history.md#v0151-and-v0152-unpublished-release-candidates).

> **`v0.15.2` was not published to PyPI.** Its release candidate passed the build, library tests, cookbook smoke and real-Azure certification, but the cookbook host-boot smoke gate failed again: the host-smoke step's `run:` value was a multi-line plain YAML scalar, so its line-continuation backslash reached the shell as `\ tests/e2e/test_package_runtime.py`, pytest reported `file or directory not found`, collected 0 items and exited with code 4, and the publish job was skipped. `0.15.3`, tagged about 22 minutes later, is the first published release after `0.15.0` and contains every change listed here. highlights: - Opt-in secure logging mode: call `configure_secure_redaction()` after logging setup for fail-closed key/pattern masking on current handlers (use `attach_secure_redaction(handler)` for late handlers). Defaults are unchanged. This is defence in depth and does not guarantee protection of arbitrary secrets in free-text messages (#617).
